turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in? I have until 4:40.
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
That's a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead. I'm going to the principal's office next anyway, and I want whatever you file in writing. Now, what else do you have besides a score?
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Then we'll both be there tomorrow. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and a written answer on who decided to enter the mark before anyone called me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got there.
What moved her: Nothing, because you gave her no document she could check, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: You opened with the detector score and then threatened to make it official, which gave her a machine's guess to attack and a threat she was already planning to meet at the principal's office.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Say in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home, then put a dated document about how the essay was written in front of her before you mention the score.
